info.title: Bingold Admin API
info.description: API for Bingold Admin Panel (RBAC, Blogs, News) and the BingoPay merchant payment layer on top of BinGold.

tags.name: Vendor SSO
tags.description: Partner/SSO-facing vendor flow: QR handoff, register/login, KYC/KYB (x-api-key only, vendors addressed by uuid)

tags.description: Vendor self-service: onboarding, QR, KYC, dashboard, withdraw

tags.name: BingoPay - Pay
tags.description: Customer QR payment flow: resolve, quote, confirm

tags.name: BingoPay Admin - Vendors
tags.description: Admin: vendor onboarding, approval, KYC (online + offline)
